newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - November 7.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - November 7.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Thursday. Reuter has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - President Bill Clinton wins landside victory in U.S. election.
UNITED DAILY NEWS - Gary Locke elected as governor of Washington state.
COMMERCIAL TIMES - Finance Ministry, Interior Ministry and Council of Agriculture agree to review regulations on farmers' credit associations.
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - U.S. President Bill Clinton wins re-election, boosting international financial markets.
Taiwan stock index gains while local currency falls over U.S. presidential election result.
